decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies on the 23rd of February 2005, that the proposed single storey side infill extension received on the 23rd of February 2005, dimensions:  Depth = 5.94m, Width = 1.86m, Height = 2.6m (parapet wall) and 3.6m (height of single pitch roof) which increases the original volume of the house at 22 Grove Park Terrace, W4 34.02m3 would be lawful in terms of section 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended)

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE
If work commences on any other extension before the side rear infill extension subject to this decision is completed, this may invalidate the lawful development certificate for the side rear infill extension.  As a result your client may be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20 000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey rear infill extension to house.
